text: All tips go in one pool at close. Servers get 1 point an hour, bartenders 1.5, bussers and hosts 0.5. The kitchen shares too at 0.5 an hour, since we pay everyone at least $16.50. Managers don't share. Card fees of 2.9% come off the top.

Front of house pools tips each night. Servers and bartenders earn 1 point an hour, bussers earn 0.5. Cooks and dishwashers aren't in the pool. Tipped staff are paid $2.13 an hour plus tips. Pool money is paid with the next regular paycheck.

Tips are pooled nightly and shared by hours worked: servers 1 point, hosts 0.5. Parties of 8 or more get an 18% service charge, which we pay out as wages through payroll, so it is not a tip. No manager or supervisor shares in the pool.

We share tips the same night through PayPal or Venmo. Servers earn 1 point an hour, bartenders 1.25, barbacks and food runners 0.5. Only staff working during service share. Servers and bartenders are paid $2.13 an hour plus tips.

All tips are pooled. Everyone is paid at least $18 an hour, so nobody relies on tips for base pay. Servers earn 1 point an hour, cooks 0.5, and the morning prep crew 0.5 as well. The owner and general manager take nothing from the pool.
All tips go in one pool. Servers earn 1 point an hour and bussers 0.5. Our managers work hard on the floor, so managers get 5% of the pool off the top each night.
Tips are pooled at close and split by hours. Servers earn 1 point an hour, hosts 0.5. Before the split, the house keeps 3% of the pool to cover breakage and walkouts.
Everyone shares in tonight's tips. Servers earn 1 point an hour and cooks earn 0.5 points an hour. Servers are paid $2.13 an hour plus tips.

Servers pay into the support pool every night. Servers earn 1 point an hour. Bussers and hosts earn 0.5, including the morning crew who set up and clean the dining room before we open at 4pm. Servers are paid $2.13 an hour plus tips.
We pool all tips. Servers earn 1 point an hour. Shift supervisors, who write the schedule and handle hiring, earn 1.5 points an hour from the pool.
